Method of Attack: stealing sensitive information like AWS credentials and transmitting it to publicly exposed endpoints
data exfiltration, snatching AWS credentials, network interface information, and environment variables
Discoverer: Sonatype analysts J. Cardona and C. Fernandez
Attack Vector: malicious packages uploaded to PyPI repository
Indicators of Compromise: TXT files containing stolen AWS credentials
uploading data to PyGrata.com domain endpoint (publicly exposed)
